name: Weekday 7am premarket scan
prompt:
Weekday 7am ET US premarket board (America/New_York). Run the Ross-style small-cap gapper scan: price $2–$20, relative volume ≥5x average daily, float ≤20M, news preferred, gap vs prior close ≥10%. Four of five boxes is a pass; news is the skippable box (China/no-news ramps still make the board if the other four hit). Rank gap-and-go vs fade.

Deliver a tight board to the user in this chat: ticker, last, gap %, PM volume, rvol vs ADV, float, boxes hit (e.g. 4/5 missed news), one-line catalyst or "none found." Skip buyouts and unverified OTC. Never invent prices, volume, or float. If the market is closed for a holiday, say so in one line and stay otherwise quiet. If nothing hits 4/5, say none found.

A one-line "outside the box" footnote is OK for liquid mega-cap earnings gappers the user already follows, but do not mix them into the Ross ranked list.
